scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mdt/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,desktop -c gray,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @mdt/shared" "npm run dev -w @mdt/api" "npm run dev -w @mdt/desktop"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @mdt/shared && concurrently -n shared,api -c gray,cyan "npm run dev -w @mdt/shared" "npm run dev -w @mdt/api"
scripts.dev:bot: npm run build -w @mdt/shared && concurrently -n shared,bot -c gray,magenta "npm run dev -w @mdt/shared" "npm run dev -w @mdt/bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mdt/shared && npm run build -w @mdt/api && npm run build -w @mdt/bot && npm run build -w @mdt/desktop
scripts.build:win: npm run build -w @mdt/shared && npm run build:win -w @mdt/desktop
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @mdt/shared && prisma db seed
scripts.lint: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/bot/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
